snippet.title: Moedan Short Gameplay
snippet.description:
Moedan (萌える弾幕STG もえだん Moeru Danmaku STG Moedan, literally "Cute Curtain Fire Shooting Game, Moedan") is a practice/training shmup, featuring some of the cast of the Touhou series (Flandre Scarlet, Alice Margatroid). It also features characters from another series, Moetan,[1] a series of books which teaches Japanese people to say incredibly silly and useless things in English. The engine, naturally, bears a lot of similarities to the standard Touhou engine (including graze, shift key to move slower, visible hit box when slow, etc.)


Moedan Project Single-player Story Mode, Single-player Spell Card Practice Mode The full name is 萌える英単語もえたん (Moeru Eitango, Moetan,) literally "Cute English Vocabulary, Moetan." Moetan is also short for "Methodology of English, the Academic Necessity."
